name: Lobelia Sackville-Baggins

abilities.text: When Lobelia enters, exile target creature card from an opponent's graveyard that was put there from the battlefield this turn, then create X Treasure tokens, where X is the exiled card's power.

notes: APPROXIMATION: no Filter field records HOW a card reached a graveyard, so 'that was put there from the battlefield this turn' is not restricted - any creature card in an opponent's graveyard is a legal target. X is the exiled card's power ('power-of-that'), read off the binding the exile leaves behind (last known values, CR 608.2h).
